title: Replying to @Sis Thee Doll We have a new Rocky Horror Playbill design...
transcript: We finally have an update on the Rocky Horror Playbill, as earlier this month they released this Playbill design and the internet did not really love it. However, just like ugly Sonic and the new Cracker Barrel logo, it seems the internet has successfully bullied them into releasing a new Playbill cover, and that's this one, which seems to be the playbill that they will use when they start previews next month. It's definitely much simpler and more classic than the previous version. while the color scheme does kind of give Jamie Lloyd Sunset Boulevard, it also feels like a nice homage to the famous red lips on a black background that were featured at the start of the film and on the previous revivals Playbill cover. Now remains to be seen if this will be their permanent cover, as many shows will launch with much simpler artwork and then do a full rebrand once they open and are able to utilize things like cast members in costumes or production photos. What do you think of the new design? Do you think it's an improvement on the previous version? Did you like the previous version and thought it was creative? Let me know. I think personally I may have preferred something that use the cast portraits that they already put out, because I really love the design aesthetic that they use for them, and they look really good on their poster as well.
